title: August 2026 Special Offer
meta_description: Chimwemwe Driving School August 2026 special offer — new learners get 20% off eligible driving lessons.
body:
## Discounted driving lessons

For the entire month of August, new learners can receive a **20% discount** on eligible driving lessons.

## Offer details

- **Offer:** Discounted driving lessons
- **Discount:** 20%
- **Valid from:** 1 August 2026
- **Valid until:** 31 August 2026
- **Available to:** New learners only

## Why choose Chimwemwe Driving School2?

We are committed to helping learners develop the knowledge, practical skills and confidence needed to become safe and responsible drivers. Our training includes:

- Professional driving instruction
- Practical driving lessons
- Road safety and traffic awareness
- Vehicle control and handling
- Preparation for driving tests
- Guidance from experienced instructors

## How to claim the offer

1. Contact Chimwemwe Driving School.
2. Mention the **August 2026 Special Offer**.
3. Choose your driving lesson or package.
4. Receive your 20% discount.

This offer is available for a limited time only and ends on **31 August 2026**. [Contact us](contact.html) to get started.
